build_task_with_define_task_decorator: use the define_task decorator to register a build_task function that creates a PHYRE spatial reasoning task
create_box_with_add_box: call C.add_box(width, height) to create a box body and chain set_bottom and set_left to position it
set_spatial_relationship_touching: use C.SpatialRelationship.TOUCHING in update_task relationships list to define a touching spatial relationship between two bodies
update_task_with_bodies_and_relationship: call C.update_task with body1, body2, relationships list, and description string to finalize the task definition
review_build_task_function: review the build_task function to understand how boxes are positioned and spatial relationships are defined
